The public AllocationAwareBLAKE3 and blake3 exports consumed by Namespace checkpoints

Retain later streaming/keyed APIs introduced by genuine identity-owner evolution at commit 78d6d2fcd79d0bd93d54d21cc31e8cd4c3baa70d
